title: Mend normalized program record
description: One drug-development programme, normalized. The top-level shape is exactly what the Zero Downtime scaffold's normalizeWebRecords() emits, so src/records.mjs needs no change to consume it. schema.id is 'meridian.program', schema.version is 1.

id.description: sha256(sourceUrl + '\0' + label) truncated to 16 hex chars, per the scaffold.

sourceUrl.description: Canonical URL of the programme detail page.

attributes.description: Mapped fields. additionalProperties is deliberately true: an unexpected key is a requirement change (EVOLVE), not a conformance failure, and is reported through unmapped_fields_seen instead.

phase.description: The field that v2 breaks. Typed as a non-empty string with no null branch on purpose — an extractor that finds nothing MUST emit null here, which fails validation and drives schema_conformance down. If null were permitted the silent failure would stay silent.
